response.description: Azure API Management now offers the Unified Model API, a standardized way to connect applications to AI models from multiple providers without managing different API interfaces and integration requirements.Building applications with multiple AI models often requires developers to accommodate provider-specific APIs, SDKs, and request formats. The Unified Model API removes this complexity by translating requests and responses between a common API format, such as OpenAI Chat Completions, and supported model providers, including OpenAI and Anthropic.This capability enables organizations to:Accelerate AI application development: Integrate with multiple model providers using a single API interface and familiar development tools.Enable model choice and portability: Adopt new models, switch providers, and implement failover strategies with minimal application changes.Maintain consistent governance: Secure, monitor, and manage model traffic through a centralized API management platform, regardless of the underlying provider.With the Unified Model API, organizations can evolve their AI architectures as model capabilities and business requirements change, while maintaining a consistent developer experience and centralized control.Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Unified Model API in Azure API Management
